runtime_scope: Final growth-fixed bounded reader; current runtime under external cgroup budgets. Comparison version override 0.3.0. Separate from the historical September 19 campaign.
timing_conditions: Docker Desktop Linux/arm64 VM on an ARM64 macOS host. No competing local benchmark; ordinary host/VM background activity not controlled. One observation per configuration, cache warmed by input validation/references. No performance distribution or speedup claim.
memory_measurement: Cgroup memory includes supervisor and output cache. Sampled memory.current is a lower bound on actual peak when memory.peak is unavailable. This is not standalone dircue peak RSS.
scope_limits: Languages, project and graph reports only; no structural worker, scc metrics or package-import budget characterization.
512 MiB cgroup limits are externally enforced; no new dircue resource flags or hard in-process guarantees.
Unrestricted references use the same executable, not the historical September 19 executable.
negative_probe_note: The 32 MiB probe is recorded separately from acceptance. This run reported Docker OOMKilled=true and exit 137; its supervisor also died, leaving no final child receipt. Captured output was rejected.
